newsitem.title: UK: Thirty injured in chemical spill at London airport.
newsitem.headline: Thirty injured in chemical spill at London airport.

text.p: About 30 people were taken to hospital from London's Heathrow airport on Saturday after they were overcome by fumes from toxic chemicals spilled from an airliner's cargo, emergency services said.
None of the victims, most of whom were airport workers, was seriously injured and most were released after treatment, London's ambulance service said.
The fumes came from a cocktail of 68 different chemicals in pesticides in the cargo of a British Airways Boeing 747 jumbo jet, a fire brigade spokeswoman said.

She was unable to say how they had leaked out. Fire brigade crews wearing protective suits and masks were at the scene trying to contain the spill, but the spokeswoman said the operation could take some time.
Heathrow police said the accident happened at the airport's Terminal Four 8 a.m. (GMT) and that the danger "had been contained".
